types.description: A change that gives consumers a new capability or extends an existing one.
types.label: Features

types.description: A change that removes a capability or surface on which consumers depend.
types.label: Removed

types.description: A change that marks a capability or surface for removal while the capability or surface keeps working.
types.label: Deprecated

types.description: A change that corrects behavior that consumers meet and that differs from what was intended.
types.label: Bug fixes

types.description: A change that closes a vulnerability or hardens a consumer-facing surface against attack.
types.label: Security

types.description: A change that reduces the time, memory, or other resources that consumer-facing work uses, without changing its result.
types.label: Performance

types.description: A change that adds or extends a capability that consumers do not use directly, such as a helper or an internal module.
types.label: Internal features

types.description: A change that restructures existing code without changing its behavior.
types.label: Refactoring

types.description: A change confined to tests, test fixtures, or test helpers, including one that unblocks a build or a type check.
types.label: Tests

types.description: A change to the tools used to develop the project: build, lint, formatting, and release configuration, and development scripts.
types.label: Tooling

types.description: A change to continuous-integration workflows and their configuration.
types.label: CI

types.description: A change that adds, removes, or upgrades a dependency, including its lockfile and version-catalog entries.
types.label: Dependencies

types.description: A change to guidance on working in the repository itself, such as its `AGENTS.md` or a repo-local skill, or to the repository's agent configuration.
types.label: Agentic support

types.description: A change to documentation for human readers, such as a README, a guide, or a code comment.
types.label: Documentation

types.description: A change to formatting alone, such as whitespace or line wrapping, that leaves the content unchanged.
types.label: Formatting
